title: A rep whose staff record is gone shows the name kept on the invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: A work order was invoiced today with a Parts representative whose staff record no longer exists.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} was invoiced today with "Sales Representative - Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Parts" {Staff-member-C}; since then {Staff-member-C}'s staff record no longer exists.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001 and {Staff-member-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Gone Rep.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, with Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1}'s Parts row is listed under the name captured on the invoice, {Staff-member-C}; it is not moved to Unassigned and not dropped.

A manual tester cannot set up this case: a staff record stops existing only through a data repair. The developers check it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R2: “The names captured on the invoice do not change afterwards, including when a staff member is renamed or deactivated. That is what the invoice stores. The report labels each person with their current name, as it does today, so a renamed representative stays one row; it shows the captured name only when the staff record no longer exists.”
  • S5-R1: “When a work order is invoiced, the parts representative and the labor representative in effect are both captured on the invoice, by name.”
  • Story 6 context note (S6-N1, S1-E3, S7-R6): “* Context note (S6-N1, S1-E3, S7-R6): a staff record stops existing only through a data repair; ShopView offers no way to delete one. Developers check these cases; manual QA cannot set them up.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 30: “30. (b) Only through a data repair, so the developers check it, not a manual tester.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Phase 8 fetcher tests (section 8.4): “A cross-org staff id on an invoice gives a null live name and falls back to the captured name with inactive set (D4).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
